props.name: count
props.description: How many blobs the lamp holds. With `merge`, the count it splits back up to.

props.name: size
props.description: Blob radius, as a fraction of the field's shorter side. Blobs vary around it.

props.name: goo
props.description: From 0 to 1: how far apart blobs start to reach for each other and fuse.

props.name: merge
props.description: Blobs that run into each other join for good, and big ones split at the heater.

props.name: wobble
props.description: From 0 (round) to 1 (lumpy): how far each blob's outline strays from a circle.

props.name: morph
props.description: Scales how fast the outlines change shape.

props.name: blend
props.description: From 0 (each blob keeps its own flat color) to 1 (colors fade across the whole fused shape).

props.name: refract
props.description: For `glass`: bend what is behind the glass at its edge, like a lens. Chromium only, and costly over a large field; off, the glass just softens the backdrop a touch.

props.name: color
props.description: One color for every blob; any CSS color, including `var(--token)`.

props.name: colors
props.description: Gradient stops; any CSS colors. Wins over `palette` and `color`.

props.name: palette
props.description: A ready-made gradient. Defaults to `lava` when no color is given.

props.name: liquid
props.description: Fills the vessel behind the blobs; any CSS color. Transparent by default.

props.name: seed
props.description: Picks the starting layout; change it for a different lamp.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pointer becomes a blob the others fuse with, and stirs what it passes.
